coordinator.role: Autonomous Triage, Spec Design, Gatekeeper & MR Auto-Merge

fast-coder.role: High-throughput TDD implementation, syntax review & fast coding

deep-research.role: Architecture Audit, CONTEXT.md review & Blind Adversarial Review

cheap-tests.role: Generate mock data, fixtures and property-based test stubs

ship-it.description: Intent/Spec -> TDD Build -> Gauntlet -> Blind Review -> Auto-Merge PR

clean-sweep.description: Drain finite issue backlog to zero with SHA-backed PR per finding

harden-it.description: Threat model audit -> Exploit test -> Fix -> Re-attack -> Clean re-audit

prove-it.description: Mutation testing test-gap closure with Stryker until mutants are eliminated

speed-it.description: Optimize performance against pre-declared latency/budget contract

deflake-it.description: Eradicate flaky tests through statistical repetition streak locally & CI

review-it.description: Read-only SHA-bound GO/NO-GO verdict without code mutation authority

root-cause.description: Reproduce symptom -> Falsify rival hypotheses -> Prove single root cause

autoMerge.note: A branch touching any of these paths is never auto-merged by Phase 6, regardless of Decision Gate outcome. Transition to needs-info and run the 3-action escalation protocol instead.
